sources.title: Scaling Transformers: How Linear Attention is Reshaping Cross-Task AI
sources.snippet: The solution gaining serious traction in the research community is Linear Attention. By mathematically decomposing the softmax operation and substituting carefully engineered kernel feature maps, newer architectures achieve O (N) complexity — retaining the expressivity of a standard Transformer at a fraction of the cost.
